features: compressed irregular crown at soil line
crown_reference.dimensions: 14 mm core diameter is an assumed scale, not measured from photo
crown_reference.roots: buried root mechanics omitted from harvesting-contact model

basal_support.basis: Geometry hypothesis from broad petiole bases in the Cal Poly crown reference; no measured dimensions or stiffness. Upper stalk radius and material modulus retained.
basal_support.mechanics: Bending compliance integrated over tapered radius; same tapered section used for rendering and contact.
basal_support.emergence_basis: Separate unloaded-shape hypothesis: proximal leaf stalk rises before bending outward; no growth angle measured. Leaf attachment endpoint preserved.
basal_support.attachment_basis: Embedded sheath is a fixed crown component ending at the flexible stalk origin. It must not be a moving collider buried in rigid substrate. Exposed stalk contact stays enabled.
basal_support.contact_basis: Numerical contact refinement for the stiffer structural bases; tested for penetration and timestep sensitivity. Not tissue calibration.

morphology_evidence.feature: Standing plant: petioles remain ascending through most of their length; cupped leaf faces and central developing leaves
morphology_evidence.condition: Figure 1, field-grown plant; adjacent plants overlap; dimensions not recovered

morphology_evidence.feature: Layered petiole bases and main/branch crowns
morphology_evidence.condition: Plant held apart by hands; not evidence for natural attachment angles; this candidate has one crown

morphology_evidence.feature: Short compressed crown, overlapping bases, roots below crown
morphology_evidence.condition: Trimmed bare-root specimen; cannot identify growth posture or mechanical constants

morphology_evidence.feature: Young nursery-potted plants support another canopy/central-growth comparison
morphology_evidence.condition: Different cultivar/stage/container; not a metric matched specimen

morphology_evidence.feature: Age-stratified effective Young modulus, 89 / 194 / 297 MPa, new / second / third-and-older leaves
morphology_evidence.condition: Tsubota et al. 2022, Tochiotome cultivar in forcing culture. Effective modulus inferred from axial buckling under specified supports; not a direct calibration of our bent, tapered segments. Values stated in PDF p.229; setup described on p.232.

morphology_evidence.feature: Pedicels attach through the calyx; replace the arbitrary local-down frame with terminal tangent continuity.
morphology_evidence.condition: Photographic anatomical constraint, not a measurement of attachment flexural/torsional compliance.

parameter_status.unloaded_geometry: explicit visual hypothesis; photos show loaded geometry, so rest shape remains unidentified
parameter_status.attachment_coordinates: assumed staggered crown-relative coordinates in metres
parameter_status.material_properties: Age-stratified petiole modulus uses published buckling-derived values as a prior. Mapping our leaf ages to those ranks is assumed. Truss and leaf blade material laws remain unchanged/assumed.
parameter_status.leaf_mass: assumed areal-density scaling; no specimen measurements
parameter_status.distributions: bounded engineering hypotheses, not biological statistics
parameter_status.fruit_attachment: Calyx-to-apex axis aligned with terminal pedicel in unloaded material frame. Uniform-density fruit mesh determines COM and inertia; tissue heterogeneity and local curvature unmeasured.

crown_structure.status: compressed stem with staggered petiole bases; fixed boundary; dimensions assumed

dependencies: one size variable changes petiole length/radius, leaf area/mass, and fruit dimensions/volume/mass
one openness variable changes leaf endpoint radius without moving crown attachments or substrate
one azimuth variable rotates the leaf arrangement together; fruit truss fixed for probe comparability
Age-dependent petiole modulus remains fixed across morphology seeds; crown/root boundary and leaf hinge law remain uncalibrated.
parameterization.distribution_status: uncalibrated bounded hypotheses; seeded variants are simulation holdouts, not proof of real-world generalization

roots.representation: fixed crown boundary; root geometry and pullout absent
roots.validity: above-ground contact hypothesis only; must test anchorage before transfer
